-- Annotation History table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS annotation_history (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  annotationId INT NOT NULL,
  imageUrl TEXT NOT NULL,
  versionNumber INT NOT NULL,
  annotations JSON NOT NULL,
  changeType ENUM('CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'ROLLBACK') NOT NULL,
  changeSummary TEXT,
  changedBy INT NOT NULL,
  changedByName VARCHAR(255),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_annotation_history_annotation (annotationId),
  INDEX idx_annotation_history_version (annotationId, versionNumber),
  INDEX idx_annotation_history_created (createdAt),
  INDEX idx_annotation_history_user (changedBy)
);

-- Predictive Alerts table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS predictive_alerts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  alertType ENUM('DEFECT_SPIKE', 'YIELD_DROP', 'MACHINE_FAILURE', 'QUALITY_DEGRADATION', 'PATTERN_ANOMALY') NOT NULL,
  severity ENUM('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL') DEFAULT 'MEDIUM' NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  predictedValue DECIMAL(10, 4),
  currentValue DECIMAL(10, 4),
  threshold DECIMAL(10, 4),
  confidenceScore DECIMAL(5, 2),
  predictedTimeframe VARCHAR(50),
  machineId INT,
  machineCode VARCHAR(50),
  productModelId INT,
  productModelCode VARCHAR(50),
  factoryId INT,
  aiAnalysis JSON,
  status ENUM('ACTIVE', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'RESOLVED', 'DISMISSED', 'EXPIRED') DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  acknowledgedBy INT,
  acknowledgedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  resolvedBy INT,
  resolvedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  resolutionNotes TEXT,
  notificationSent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  notificationSentAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_type (alertType),
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_severity (severity),
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_status (status),
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_machine (machineId),
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_product (productModelId),
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_factory (factoryId),
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_created (createdAt),
  INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_expires (expiresAt)
);

-- Root Cause Analysis table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS root_cause_analysis (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  analysisType ENUM('DEFECT_ANALYSIS', 'YIELD_ANALYSIS', 'QUALITY_ANALYSIS', 'MACHINE_ANALYSIS') NOT NULL,
  machineId INT,
  machineCode VARCHAR(50),
  productModelId INT,
  productModelCode VARCHAR(50),
  factoryId INT,
  startDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  endDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  dataPointsAnalyzed INT NOT NULL,
  correlationMatrix JSON,
  topFactors JSON NOT NULL,
  aiInsights JSON,
  paretoData JSON,
  status ENUM('COMPLETED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'FAILED') DEFAULT 'COMPLETED' NOT NULL,
  errorMessage TEXT,
  requestedBy INT NOT NULL,
  requestedByName VARCHAR(255),
  processingTime INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_rca_type (analysisType),
  INDEX idx_rca_machine (machineId),
  INDEX idx_rca_product (productModelId),
  INDEX idx_rca_factory (factoryId),
  INDEX idx_rca_status (status),
  INDEX idx_rca_created (createdAt),
  INDEX idx_rca_date_range (startDate, endDate)
);
